result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position by providing up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and subsequent certified deletion. However, it applies the return and deletion obligations to termination of any individual Service Option Attachment and requires return and deletion of all Customer data, even where other attachments remain active. That overbreadth is unnecessary and may disrupt continuing services, contrary to the original clause’s preservation of unaffected attachments. It should limit those obligations to data associated with the terminated attachment, or apply them globally only upon termination of the entire Agreement.
